title: feat(spec): register the ask agent's draft_record tool, with its chatbot label in all ten packs (cloud#3383)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HPWwGPwXewCPBRhUPpRoLnxR)_

Registry half of objectstack-ai/cloud#3383 (no objectstack card of its own; the same shape as #27011 for cloud#3335). Related: #28104 (the console card that renders this tool's result).

## What changes

- `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` lists `draft_record`, in alphabetical order. The group's TSDoc now also names the ask agent's hand-off signals.
- `chatbot.tool.draft_record` in all ten locale packs ("Draft the new record", 「起草新记录」, …).
- `packages/lint`: a pin that a skill naming `draft_record` resolves, with a control name that does not.
- Two changesets: `@objectstack/spec` minor (widening), `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Why

cloud#3383 (Sam's ruling on #27286, 2026-10-30: 「同意开发 S1 粘贴即建单」, then 「其实不只是粘贴吧，任何内容我都可以让他创建和更新记录是吗？通过聊天的方式。」) adds `draft_record` to cloud `service-ai-studio`: the ask agent drafts a new record from chat content, validated server-side, and the user saves it. Cloud's conformance test holds the package to exactly this registry, so the cloud PR stays red on that one test until this lands and a cloud pin round passes it. The chatbot label-parity tests read the same registry, so the label lands with the name.

## Verification

- `packages/lint` `validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts`: 22 passed.
- `ui`: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-sentences-12724.test.ts packages/i18n/`: 94 files, 1,431 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` was not run locally (CI runs it).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
